title: Optimize policy (optimize_policy.json) — bo dieu khien vong toi uu bat buoc sau baseline
description: Nguoi duyet o G2 cung playbook. Vong toi uu la buoc BAT BUOC sau baseline: coordinator chay `optimize.py next` sau moi vong cho toi khi no tra STOP. Ky luat test: error_analysis_split chi 'val'|'oof' (test khoa cham mot lan o I-final qua seal).

approved_at_G2.description: Nguoi da duyet o G2 cung playbook.

max_rounds.description: So vong toi uu toi da.

epsilon.description: Cai thien toi thieu co y nghia. null = mac dinh theo sai so chuan bo danh gia (1/2 SE).

patience.description: So vong lien tiep cai thien < epsilon thi STOP plateau.

top_k.description: So thanh phan yeu chon moi vong (khoang cach x trong so).

error_analysis_split.description: Chi val|oof. Tu choi test: tap test khoa chi cham mot lan o I-final qua seal.

data_sources.description: Nguon du lieu ngoai can dung (can duyet tung nguon).

approved_sources.description: Nguon da duoc nguoi duyet (research truoc build chi voi nguon da duyet).

metrics_source.description: Khai bao NGUON METRIC (OP3, bat buoc khi eval.json khong co eval_contract va co nhieu bang/hang ablation): chi bang khop moi duoc dung; khong khai bao -> status/next LOI fail-closed, init liet ke bang ung vien.

table_title_regex.description: Regex ten bang (khop nhieu bang thi dung tat ca).

table_index.description: Index bang trong eval.json moi nhat.

value_column.description: Cot gia tri; 'auto' = value hoac correct/total.

field_regex.description: Regex trich khoa field (nhom 1); mac dinh lay phan truoc dau '·'.

default_target.description: Target mac dinh cho moi field chua co targets.<field> (vd. 0.99 trich tu spec 'moi field >= 99%'); null = thieu target -> next STOP-hoi-nguoi.

targets.description: Target theo field lay tu spec/eval.
